title: Lake Lindero Golf Course
gap: Prices, hours and eligibility are not copied here yet. We will ask when you request.
blurb: Nestled on the border of Agoura Hills and Westlake Village, Lake Lindero Golf Course is a 9-hole Ted Robinson design that rewards both precision and smart course management. Spanning over 1,600 yards, the course winds through a natural ravine and past several scenic ponds, demanding accurate shot-making from the first tee to the final green. Success here isn’t just about power; positioning matters.
